basic_info.description: Beautiful 3-Story Victorian in the Heart of San Francisco!  Welcome to 1733 McKinnon Ave, a beautifully maintained detached Victorian home built in 1907. Located just two blocks from the Third Street light rail, this home offers quick access to Chinatown, Chase Center, UCSF, Oracle Park, and downtown San Francisco.  This single-family residence showcases pride of ownership with modern updates, including a full kitchen remodel and a new rear foundation. The top level features 2 spacious bedrooms and 1 full bathroom, accompanied by a cozy living room with a fireplace and a formal dining room. Original architectural charm meets modern convenience, with in-unit laundry and appliances such as a washer, dryer, and refrigerator included.  The property boasts a full garage with potential for an ADU conversion, providing an exciting opportunity for additional living space or rental income. Outside, enjoy a beautifully landscaped garden with a variety of fruit trees—a perfect urban oasis.  Other highlights:   • Newly paved street  • Roof is approximately 7 years old  • Easy access to public transit and major city attractions  Don’t miss this chance to own a piece of San Francisco history in a prime location!
